entries.bfd3811853582d79: The business contributes to employment through cloud services for companies engaged in human resource matching services, such as employment agencies and worker dispatch companies. Its core product, the comprehensive human resource matching management system “PORTERS,” centralizes management of job and applicant information, manages the selection process, provides matching search and form output, can be customized free of charge to suit each company's operations, and is offered on a monthly subscription basis according to the number of user IDs. It also offers the interview scheduling system “ZLOSS,” implementation support services and API integration. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥2,126 million, and this business includes the consolidated subsidiaries PORTERS ASIA SG PTE. LTD., KIKAN flex Co., Ltd. and PORTERS ASIA VIETNAM COMPANY LIMITED.
